title: ANCHOR: Cluster-Grounded 5W1H Extraction via Large-Small Model Collaboration
abstract: arXiv:2611.20728v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deep semantic understanding of events requires recognizing related events and distinguishing why an event occurs from how it is carried out. 5W1H extraction provides a structured foundation for such understanding by organizing event information around six fundamental questions. However, single-event slot filling provides limited support for these distinctions. We propose ANCHOR, a cluster-grounded framework that combines a large language model (LLM) with a small language model equipped with discriminative heads for accurate 5W1H extraction. The LLM proposes candidate events and generates their initial 4W records, which guide the selection of an event cluster and the subsequent anchoring of its main event. A shared document encoder provides evidence for joint 4W refinement, and two separate sets of boundary and role-scoring heads then extract why and how under event-specific constraints, respectively. translated_title: ANCHOR：基于聚类的5W1H抽取——大小模型协同方法
translated_abstract: 对事件的深层语义理解需要识别相关事件，并区分事件“为何发生”与“如何进行”。5W1H抽取通过围绕六个基本问题组织事件信息，为此类理解提供了结构化基础。然而，单事件槽位填充对这类区分的支持十分有限。我们提出ANCHOR，一个以聚类为基础的框架，它将大型语言模型（LLM）与配备判别头的小型语言模型相结合，以实现准确的5W1H抽取。LLM提出候选事件并生成其初始4W记录，这些记录引导事件簇的选择以及随后主事件的锚定。共享的文档编码器为联合4W细化提供证据，随后两组独立的边界与角色打分头分别在事件特定约束下抽取“为何”和“如何”。文档表示被复用以……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出ANCHOR框架，通过大小模型协同——由LLM提出候选事件并生成初始4W记录以锚定事件簇，再由小模型的判别头在事件特定约束下联合细化4W并分别抽取“为何”与“如何”——实现更准确的5W1H事件信息抽取。
en_tdlr: ANCHOR is a cluster-grounded 5W1H extraction framework that leverages large-small model collaboration, where an LLM proposes candidate events and initial 4W records to anchor event clusters, and a small model with discriminative heads refines 4W jointly and extracts why and how separately under event-specific constraints.
